apa7: Mehr, A. S., Scheffknecht, G., Zohourian, R., Reinmöller, M., & Maier, J. (2026). Design, simulation, and techno-economic evaluation of a high-capacity ammonia cracking facility for pipeline-grade hydrogen production. Energy Science & Engineering, 14(9), 4197–4212. https://doi.org/10.1002/ese3.70618
apa7_note: First author printed as 'Amin Soleimani Mehr'; publisher file name uses surname 'Mehr'. If surname is 'Soleimani Mehr' the APA form is 'Soleimani Mehr, A.'. Verify.
page_convention: PDF page numbers 1-16; journal page = 4196 + PDF page.
simulator: Aspen HYSYS V11 (storage, cracking, PSA, heat integration) + Aspen Plus V12 (H2 compression); APEA for capital cost
property_method: Peng-Robinson EOS, default binary interaction parameters
reliability_warning: Numerous internal inconsistencies (reactor pressure 17.5 vs 21 bar; conversion 98.6 vs 99.7 %; PSA purity/recovery 99.96 %/81 % vs 99.81 %/25 %; delivery 104 vs 115 bar; SEC 1.12 vs 7.54 kWh/kg; LCOH breakdown in Table 10 does not sum; kinetic alpha/beta confusion; no pre-exponential factor). Use as contextual benchmark only.

limitations: Many internal inconsistencies (reactor P 17.5 vs 21 bar; conversion 98.6 vs 99.7 %; PSA 99.96 %/81 % vs 99.81 %/25 %; PSA feed 231 kmol/h incompatible with 5726 kg/h H2; delivery 104 vs 115 bar; boil-off 0.1 vs 0.83 %/d; BOG compressor 238 vs 99.84 kW; SEC 1.12 vs 7.54 kWh/kg; Table 10 components do not sum to 8.36 EUR/kg; NH3 price 0.9 vs 0.626 EUR/kg; CAPEX base case outside stated range).

Kinetic model not reproducible: no pre-exponential factor, alpha/beta confusion (0.209 vs 0.5 vs 0.21), cited kinetic sources unreliable (Ertl Nobel lecture; unmatched 'Spatolisano et al. 2023 IJHE' reference).
Yield reported as 0.78 kg H2/kg NH3 in places - physically impossible; means fraction of theoretical H2.
No discount rate (CRF given directly), no equipment-level CAPEX, no cost correlations or scaling exponents, no catalyst price/lifetime.
No LCA; environmental claim assumes zero emissions for green NH3 cracking; quoted fossil intensities cite non-emission sources; no NOx analysis.
Reference list lacks DOIs; several vendor white papers.
relevance: Large-scale (1000 t/d NH3, ~137 t/d H2) contextual benchmark for AmCraX: fired Ni/Al2O3 tubular cracker (~480 -> 760 degC, 17.5-21 bar) whose furnace is fuelled by PSA tail gas at full load and an NH3 slipstream at part load - matches AmCraX's tail-gas burner concept; LCOH 4.8-9.0 EUR/kg (base 8.36) dominated by NH3 price. Gaussian part-load compressor efficiency correlation (Eq. 5, eta_max 0.8, sigma 0.2) is reusable as an assumption. Because of internal inconsistencies, do not use its kinetics, SEC or LCOH breakdown as quantitative validation targets.
